description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the CustomFieldService within the OrangeHRM system, testing various methods such as DAO retrieval, getter/setter generation, field extraction, and handling custom field data scenarios.

classes.name: CustomFieldServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the CustomFieldService, testing methods for DAO retrieval, getter/setter generation, field extraction, and custom field data handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Verifies that getCustomFieldDao() returns an instance of CustomFieldDao.

methods.name: testGenerateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Checks that generateGettersByFieldNumbers() produces the correct mapping of field numbers to getter method names.

methods.name: testGenerateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Ensures generateFieldKeyByFieldId() returns the correct field key string based on the field ID.

methods.name: testGenerateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Verifies generateSetterByFieldKey() returns the correct setter method name for a given field key.

methods.name: testExtractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Tests that extractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys() accurately extracts numeric IDs from field key strings.

methods.name: testGetAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Mocks CustomFieldDao to simulate in-use fields, verifying getAllFieldsInUse() returns correct list of field numbers.

methods.name: testDeleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraDataWhenNotDeleteOption
methods.description: Simulates deletion of extra data without using delete option, verifying methods are called appropriately.

methods.name: testDeleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraDataWhenDeleteOption
methods.description: Simulates deletion of extra data with delete option enabled, verifying methods are called appropriately.
